tools/simulation/bootstrap.sh.name: Test farm secrets setup
tools/simulation/bootstrap.sh.description: Generates the passwords and secrets the test farm needs.

tools/simulation/harness-login-body.test.name: Login reply safety tests
tools/simulation/harness-login-body.test.description: Checks the load-test tools never record the sign-in challenge from a failed login, since it works like a password.

tools/simulation/k6/auth-smoke.js.name: Sign-in quick check
tools/simulation/k6/auth-smoke.js.description: Quick check against the live test farm that the load-test sign-in code works.

tools/simulation/k6/auth.js.name: Load test sign-in
tools/simulation/k6/auth.js.description: Signs simulated users in, builds their request headers and renews their session during load tests.

tools/simulation/k6/baseline.js.name: Baseline load test
tools/simulation/k6/baseline.js.description: Runs a warm-up then a measured busy period of simulated staff using the app, and reports only the measured part.

tools/simulation/k6/bundles.js.name: Screen request sets
tools/simulation/k6/bundles.js.description: Groups the requests each app screen makes so simulated users repeat them, and counts any unexpected replies.

tools/simulation/k6/config.js.name: Load test settings
tools/simulation/k6/config.js.description: Shared addresses and sign-in settings used by the load tests.

tools/simulation/k6/dates.js.name: Load test dates
tools/simulation/k6/dates.js.description: Date helpers so simulated reports and entries use sensible, not-in-the-future dates.

tools/simulation/k6/dates.test.mjs.name: Load test date checks
tools/simulation/k6/dates.test.mjs.description: Checks the report date range always ends on a valid day whatever hour the test runs.

tools/simulation/k6/persona-smoke.js.name: Persona quick check
tools/simulation/k6/persona-smoke.js.description: Quick check against the live test farm that each simulated user type runs without unexpected replies.

tools/simulation/k6/personas/manager.js.name: Simulated manager
tools/simulation/k6/personas/manager.js.description: Loop of weighted actions a simulated farm manager does during load tests.

tools/simulation/k6/personas/owner.js.name: Simulated owner
tools/simulation/k6/personas/owner.js.description: Loop of weighted actions a simulated owner or admin does during load tests.

tools/simulation/k6/personas/readonly.js.name: Simulated read-only user
tools/simulation/k6/personas/readonly.js.description: Loop of weighted actions a simulated read-only user does during load tests.

tools/simulation/k6/personas/sales.js.name: Simulated sales user
tools/simulation/k6/personas/sales.js.description: Loop of weighted actions a simulated sales user does during load tests.

tools/simulation/k6/personas/worker.js.name: Simulated worker
tools/simulation/k6/personas/worker.js.description: Loop of weighted actions a simulated farm worker does during load tests.

tools/simulation/k6/totp.js.name: Load test authenticator codes
tools/simulation/k6/totp.js.description: Makes the two-step sign-in codes for the simulated owner, waiting for the next time window rather than reusing one.

tools/simulation/k6/totp.test.mjs.name: Authenticator code tests
tools/simulation/k6/totp.test.mjs.description: Checks the load-test code generator gives correct two-step sign-in codes with a fixed clock.

tools/simulation/monitor/docker-stats-sa.name: Server load sampler
tools/simulation/monitor/docker-stats-sa.description: Records how much computer power each part of the test farm uses during a load test.

tools/simulation/monitor/pg-snapshot.sh.name: Database snapshot sampler
tools/simulation/monitor/pg-snapshot.sh.description: Takes periodic snapshots of how the test database is doing during a load test.

tools/simulation/reset.sh.name: Rebuild test farm
tools/simulation/reset.sh.description: Wipes and rebuilds the test farm from scratch, then checks it started, was filled with sample data and is safely reachable.

tools/simulation/run-baseline.sh.name: Run load test
tools/simulation/run-baseline.sh.description: Runs a full load test: starts the monitors, runs the baseline and gathers the results.

tools/simulation/totp.py.name: Authenticator code script
tools/simulation/totp.py.description: Prints a two-step sign-in code for the test owner for use in scripts.

tools/simulation/verify-harness.sh.name: Load test self-check
tools/simulation/verify-harness.sh.description: Cheap check that the load-test tools themselves are in working order.
